results.description: This poster is about the New Zealand government's controversial agreement with Australia to purchase four Anzac-class frigates at a cost of $2 billion. The frigates were to be built in Australia with involvement from New Zealand industry, and were part of an Australian initiative to boost naval power in the South Pacific. Many questioned why New Zealand needed frigates, and critics argued that social needs were greater than those of defence.Kim Beazley was the Australian Minister of Defence.The protest campaign was partially successful: only two frigates were eventually purchased.
